title: Acme Fit: marketing site, spring refresh
subtitle: The home page as a hi-fi mockup and the blog live from the dev server. Comment on any section or element, pick a hero headline and a pricing lead, then approve the round.

state.label: home: mockup; blog: live dev server

tldr: Two pages: the home page as a mockup of the refresh, and the blog live from `npm run dev` on localhost:4321. Pick the hero headline and which plan leads the pricing table; each version shows in place on the page. Check each page at desktop, tablet and mobile widths.

sections.title: Brief
sections.lead: The home page must turn a visitor into a trial in one scroll.

blocks.md: Visitors arrive from app store links and search, mostly on phones. The hero says what Acme Fit does, the features show the three things members use daily, and the pricing table ends the scroll with one plan and two ways to pay. Copy lives in `src/content/home.ts`; layout in `src/components/`.

items.sub: Recommend Habit first: trial members who set a weekly goal stay twice as long.

choices.label: Track everything
choices.md: The current headline: nothing to change. It names no feature from this release.

choices.label: Habit first
choices.md: Leads with weekly goals, the feature this release adds. Trial members who set one stay twice as long.

choices.label: Coach first
choices.md: Leads with coach notes. Only members on a watch see them, so it speaks to fewer visitors.

items.text: Which plan leads the pricing table?
items.sub: Recommend Monthly: it is the plan the free trial converts to.

choices.label: Monthly
choices.md: The plan the free trial converts to, first in the table. The table shows the monthly price, not the yearly saving.

choices.label: Yearly
choices.md: Leads with the lower price per month and the saving. A trial member has to pick it over the plan the trial defaults to.

sections.title: Pages
sections.lead: Two pages: the home page mockup and the live blog, each with its sections and where their source lives.
